title: The positive multiplication kernel has square cardinality
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero with decidable equality, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. For every natural number n > 0, the type of points P in W.toAffine.Point satisfying n • P = 0 is finite and has cardinality n². Here scalar multiplication and zero are those of the usual Weierstrass point group, including its identity point.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Finite {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0} ∧ Nat.card {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0} = n ^ 2
